quarterly_data.signal: Quantum: FPT signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Quandela, a French maker of photonic quantum computers, covering technical consulting and research, technology integration, workforce training, development roadmaps and research into quantum computing and quantum communication applications; the two may run initial feasibility experiments and share access to laboratories, equipment and software, and may later explore expanding to other markets. FPT says it is its first partnership with a company specializing in quantum hardware development, extending its activities to the potential to research, integrate and evaluate quantum computers.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: partner (MoU; quantum hardware and technical consulting)
